title: Implement Request Body Parsing
description: This feature adds the ability to parse JSON request bodies, allowing developers to easily access and manipulate request data. It will improve performance and simplify development by reducing the need for manual parsing. This will enable yantraverse to handle a wider range of use cases and improve overall user experience
acceptance: Request body parsing works correctly for JSON and URL-encoded data, and handles invalid JSON without crashing the server
reason: This feature is high-impact because it solves a real problem for developers using yantraverse, and is well-scoped to fit within the 100-250 line code limit, making it a priority for feature development
